title: Resolution to update groups receiving City budget funding
summary: This resolution approves new and changed designations of organizations that receive discretionary funding under the City's Fiscal Year 2026 and 2027 Expense Budgets, covering dozens of programs from senior services to violence prevention. It also amends the funding purposes for some organizations. Some listed groups have not yet completed required prequalification review, and some funding will not take effect until a budget modification passes.
